title: Georgia wildfires May 3 — Pineland Road 32,575ac 44% contained, Hwy 82 22,532ac 64%
snippet: As of May 3, 2026: Pineland Road Fire burned 32,575 acres with 44% containment; Highway 82 Fire burned 22,532 acres with 64% containment. Together 50,000+ acres. Over 120 homes destroyed — most in Georgia history. Extreme drought in U.S. Southeast fueling fires. Landsat 8 false-color imagery (bands 7-5-4) shows charred forests and residential areas.
tag_reason: 후속: 화재 면적·봉쇄율 갱신 (Pineland Road 44%, Hwy 82 64%). 이전 보고 대비 진화 진전 유의미.
